Theorem
[Total Curvature Theorem]

1. ch1:1.6

If $\gamma \colon [a,b]\to \mathbb R^2$ is a unit-speed simple closed curve with $\gamma '(a)=\gamma '(b)$ and $N$ is the inward-pointing normal, then \[ \int _a^b\kappa _N(t)\, dt=2\pi . \]
